text:
incident-bot: PAGER: [prod] elevated 5xx rate detected in gateway-prod-east. Paging @oncall-maria. Customer impact: ~3% failing requests across ingress, errors show upstream timeout -> gateway 502/504. Runbook: https://redwood.tools/runbooks/gateway-5xx. Correlation IDs present in logs (example corid=abc123...). Please ack and start mitigation.

oncall-maria: ack — i'm on it. pulling traces + kv logs now. starting mitigation: lower gateway retries and enable fallback route to model-small in us-east.

sanjay: looking at routing telemetry — big spike in retry count around 12:01 UTC, upstream queue depth jumped. hypothesis: retry amplification (client retries + gateway retries). pulling kvlog for corids.

eli: log sample: ```2026-03-17T12:01:02Z gateway ERROR request_id=abc123 upstream_timeout=30000ms status=504 path=/v1/chat``` — buyer-facing errors show upstream timeout.

oncall-maria: uploaded log bundle to dropbox: https://dropbox.com/s/abcd1234/logbundle.tar.gz :lock: — contains gateway logs + ingress traces for corids I pulled.

tom: enabled temporary fallback route 'fallback-small' at 12:03:40 for affected prefix; monitoring. :rocket:

sanjay: metrics: 5xx rate peaked 12:01:30-12:02:20, returned toward baseline by 12:05:10 after fallback. request volume steady; p95 upstream latency increased concurrently.

oncall-maria: customer impact note: /chat endpoints had errors for ~8m, estimated ~2% of active sessions affected. informing CS.

cs-bot: Notified #support-escalations and started customer incident triage.

eli: hypotheses so far:
- H1: upstream model pool saturation -> increased upstream timeouts -> gateway returned 504; gateway retry ladder amplified failed attempts.
- H2: config regression — retry policy accidentally raised to high value leading to amplification for specific routes. collecting config diffs.

sanjay: checking router config: `kubectl -n infra get configmap router-config -o yaml | grep -n retry` shows `max_retries: 5` for chat-route. that seems high.

tom: that was changed in the 11:59 deploy (throughput tuning). rolling back retry config to 2 now (rolling update started).

oncall-maria: rollback completed at 12:06:12 (deploy id deploy-20260317-1187). observing 5xx drop in metrics. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident timeline appended: https://redwood.tools/incidents/3423456789 — please add notes & assign RCA owners.

eli: next actions: write RCA, quantify total customer error volume, run replay/load tests against upstream capacity, add guardrails in routing (per-user retry cap + absolute max). tagging @tom @sanjay for follow-up.

oncall-maria: handing off to eng-sre for RCA and postmortem. leaving detailed notes in the incident doc. great collaboration — thanks team. :pray:
__notes: Single-thread Slack export style: messages in chronological order, prefixed with sender display name. No title field per agents.md.
